features.name: Barber twilio_phone_number field + /agent endpoint
features.description: Add a twilio_phone_number field to the Barber model (adminprofile app). Capability is fake for now — just a place to store the phone number. Then add a POST endpoint at /agent in the chat app that parses the request, looks up the barber matching the provided twilio_phone_number, and returns that barber. Endpoint should be reachable via ./init.sh verification.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: all 4 checks pass (exit 0). manage.py check clean, migrate --check clean. NOTE: step 4 reports 'Found 0 test(s)' because Django's manage.py test runner with no label does not auto-discover across INSTALLED_APPS in this layout. The 6 tests written under cuts/chat/tests.py (BarberAgentEndpointTests) all pass when run explicitly: 'cutz2/bin/python cuts/manage.py test chat -v 2' -> 'Ran 6 tests in 0.671s OK'. Tests cover: 200 on known barber, 404 on unknown phone, 400 on missing field, 400 on invalid JSON, 405 on GET, role=BARBER filter excludes CLIENT with same phone. Migration 0008_customuser_twilio_phone_number generated and applied. /agent/ is reachable via chat.urls mounted at /agent/ in cuts/cuts/urls.py.
